Questions

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Which platforms do you manage?

Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and X, with the mix chosen by where your audience actually spends time.

Do you shoot original content?

Yes. We plan and produce photo and video shoots, and create platform-native short-form content in-house.

Can you manage content in Malayalam and Arabic?

Yes. We create content in English and Malayalam, and work with native-language partners for Arabic content in the GCC.
